text.10_Musaf for Yom Kippur, 3_Kedushah, 23_: Then before creation. A dwelling and Yinon were set: Loftiest heights from the beginning. Prepared before any people or tongue: His Presence is firmly there to rest. Guiding the errant in paths of integrity: If wickedness turns red, wash and purify beforehand: If wrath flares in His anger, The Holy One will not arouse all His fury: We have been cut off by our iniquity until now. Our Rock has not turn to us: Departed from us is our righteous Mashiach. We were left in astonishment with nobody to justify us. And the yoke of our iniquities and rebellions, he carries it and is profaned for our transgressions. Upon his shoulder our sins. To find forgiveness for our iniquities: We are healed by his wound. Everlasting creature is regenerated anew. [chazan:] From the circle of the planet bring him up. From Seir lead him forth: To let us hear upon Mount Lebanon. A second time by the hand of Yinon.
